chunks: Are the ones who hasten to goodness and outpace the others.
ai.seo_question: What are the defining characteristics of the believers regarding good deeds?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Sabiqun* (the foremost), reflecting the Prophet's and Ahl al-Bayt's constant striving in worship and governance. It underscores the virtue of *Tasabiq* (racing in good deeds), encouraging believers to not only perform acts but to do so with excellence and speed, mirroring the spiritual priority of the Imams.
